newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Three children die in pre-dawn Manila blaze.
newsitem.headline: Three children die in pre-dawn Manila blaze.

text.p: Three children died in a pre-dawn fire that gutted part of a slum area in suburban Pasig city in Manila on Tuesday, a fire officer said.
The three siblings, a two-year-old girl and boys aged five and six, were asleep upstairs when a candle started a fire on the house's lower floor, the officer said.
Their father, who escaped unscathed, was unable to save the children.
No other casualties were reported in the fire, which raged for an hour and destroyed six houses before it was put out.
